title: malus rivularis
intro: Malus rivularis, commonly known as the streamer crabapple, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Malus rivularis include acting as an anti-diarrheal, anti-ulcer, and antioxidant agent, helping to alleviate symptoms of digestive disorders and promote overall health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
